systems.name: 4.1 Keyframe Animation
systems.notes: Learn the animation timeline, keyframes, and interpolation.
tasks: Create a simple idle animation (bobbing up and down)
Animate a walk cycle with at least 4 keyframes
Use the graph editor to refine easing

systems.name: 4.2 Rigging Basics
systems.notes: Add bones to a model and weight‑paint influence.
tasks: Create a skeleton for a humanoid model
Bind the mesh to the armature
Test the rig with a simple pose

systems.name: 4.3 Animated Textures & Effects
systems.notes: Use frame‑by‑frame textures to create glowing eyes, flipping pages, etc.
tasks: Create a texture with multiple frames
Assign the animated texture to a model’s face
Play back the animation in the viewport
